findings.detail: Besides the intended kill, the Core restarted twice on its own: pid 24192 -> 7492 at 14:40:57 (itself after a 14:40:51 'exited (1)') and pid 7492 -> 20240 at 14:45:58. Both are logged as 'the Core we started exited (1) — starting it again'. Exit code 1 on Windows is TerminateProcess, i.e. an external kill, and the Core printed NO crash output. A Core left alone was stable: pid 20240 survived 60 s idle and pid 7492 survived 45 s after a direct POST /chat. A concurrent agent is working in this repo (Claude Code hook events fire throughout kai.log), so the most likely cause is external activity, not a product defect. It does not affect the proofs above: only one Core ever listened on 8788, and each proof's observations fell inside windows where the Core behaviour was as expected.

While the island is OFFLINE (Core down), a chat turn is answered by the Hermes worker fallback and displayed as KAI's reply, bypassing the Core relay's worker-identity guard. If the product intent is 'Core offline => honest failure', claude.rs::send() should not fall through to hermes_chat when the island has declared the Core offline.
